data.one_liner: Flutter chart toolkit providing line, bar, pie, radar, gauge, and heatmap charts.
data.what_it_does: Draws various charts using CustomPainter with built-in intro animations, tooltips, legends, and light/dark themes. Supports cartesian, statistical, part-to-whole, flow, and comparison chart families.
use_when: You need a wide variety of charts like line, bar, pie, radar, and gauge drawn with CustomPainter.
You want built-in support for animations, hover and touch tooltips, and themes.
avoid_when: You need advanced mapping or specific non-chart data visualizations not covered by the toolkit.
strengths: Large collection of chart types including 27+ chart variants.
Built-in intro animations, tooltips, and light/dark themes.
Supports zoom and pan, dual y-axes, and custom drawing via ChartCanvas.
weaknesses: Documentation outside the README is minimal.
Zoomable charts capture drag gestures and require careful placement within scrolling layouts.

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: For a widely adopted, community-tested charting library focusing on standard cartesian and pie charts.

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_charts
alternatives.why_pick_it: For an enterprise-grade, highly performant charting suite with extensive documentation and support.
